description: This file defines the `VacancyDecorator` class, which provides additional methods for manipulating and accessing information about `Vacancy` entities within the OrangeHRM system. It primarily offers utility methods to set related entities by ID and check the vacancy's publication status.

classes.name: VacancyDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Vacancy entity, providing methods to associate Jobs and Employees by ID, and to check vacancy status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a Vacancy entity.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle of the vacancy using a given ID.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the current Vacancy entity being decorated.

methods.name: setEmployeeById
methods.description: Sets the Employee (hiring manager) for the vacancy using a given ID.

methods.name: isActiveAndPublished
methods.description: Checks if the vacancy is both published and active (status true).
